title: BirdCLEF+ 2026
problem: Identify which of 234 bird, amphibian, mammal and insect species are vocalizing in 5-second windows of unlabeled tropical soundscape recordings.
approach: EfficientNet classifier over log-mel spectrograms, 46k recordings, OGG decoded to mel on the fly
Two complementary models ensembled at submission time to bridge the focal-to-soundscape domain gap
Training data is single-species and weakly labeled; the hidden test set is multi-species soundscapes
constraint: CPU-only, no internet, under 90 minutes — deployed as INT8 ONNX

outcome.context: best of 6 scored submissions; competition still running

title: AMIA Public Challenge 2026
problem: Detect 14 thoracic findings in chest radiographs where each image is annotated independently by several radiologists who disagree.
approach: Weighted Box Fusion across radiologists at IoU 0.4, treating each as a separate model so the fused score encodes agreement
5-fold MultilabelStratifiedKFold over the 14-class multi-hot vector, fixed seed for identical splits across runs
Detector gated by a normal/abnormal classifier, then multi-scale TTA and WBF over 10 result sets per image
constraint: No horizontal flip — PA-view laterality is diagnostic for Cardiomegaly and Aortic enlargement

outcome.context: first submission, pipeline end-to-end; tuning in progress

title: Motion-S: Text-to-Sign Motion Generation
problem: Map English text and gloss into a 6-layer RVQ token grid that decodes into sign-language motion through a frozen organizer-provided RVQ-VAE.
approach: DistilBERT length predictor assigns one of 32 duration bins before any token is generated
MoMask masked transformer ensembled with T2M-GPT under classifier-free guidance
Frozen RVQ tokenizer with 6 layers and a 512-entry codebook, used only for encode and decode
constraint: The RVQ-VAE checkpoint is fixed, so generation must land in exactly its token space

title: Gemma 4 Developer Agent
problem: Resolve SWE-bench-style software issues with a purely declarative Google ADK agent — YAML and prompts, no Python entrypoint.
approach: Identified context, not the time budget, as the binding constraint: a 32k window with compaction forgets its own reproduction output by roughly turn seven
Spends the budget across many short disposable contexts rather than one long trajectory, which drives the orchestrator topology
Submission is a declarative config bundle scored by the host harness on resolution rate
constraint: Declarative config only — no Python entrypoints; 60 minutes and 100 tool calls per task

title: Covered — Grounded Coverage Navigator
problem: Answer real health-coverage questions from public government documents, where answering wrongly is worse than not answering at all.
approach: Every claim must trace to a retrieved span of a source document, with the citation carried through to the answer
Abstains outright when the retrieved evidence does not support an answer
Multi-hop by design: identify the program, find the eligibility rule, compute an income threshold against the Federal Poverty Level, then check the service
constraint: No ungrounded claims — the system must refuse rather than guess

title: JED Attack — AI Agent Security
problem: Red-team tool-using LLM agents by searching for multi-step attacks that defeat a guardrail, for an OpenAI, Google and IEEE challenge.
approach: Found an asymmetry in the defense: the guardrail blocks on substring matching, but the scorer decodes base64, hex and URL encoding before matching
An encoded exfiltration call therefore passes the DLP filter while still firing at maximum severity
Search loop maintains a cell archive, since the objective rewards distinct high-severity attack variants rather than a single working one
constraint: Attacks must survive both a public and an unseen private guardrail

outcome.context: best of 2 submissions; competition still running

title: NVIDIA Nemotron Reasoning
problem: Fine-tune a 30B reasoning model with a rank-32 LoRA adapter on teacher-distilled chain-of-thought traces, submitting the adapter rather than a model.
constraint: QLoRA on a single H100; adapter must load into vLLM at max_lora_rank 32

outcome.context: first submission; QLoRA adapter served through vLLM

title: DefenceRAG
problem: Answer questions over Indian defence procurement and policy documents with the source document and section attributed for every answer.
constraint: Must return the source PDF and section bucket alongside each answer

title: Multi-Agent Debate System
problem: Two AI debaters argue opposite sides of any topic and an impartial judge decides, with the judging engineered against its own biases.
constraint: Judge runs twice with A/B labels swapped; every decisive quote is verified in code

title: Competitive Analysis Agent
problem: Identify a company's competitors, research each one, and write a strategic competitive report with every finding cited to a search result.
constraint: Structured output validated in code, with one retry listing the specific problems

title: LMSYS Chatbot Arena — Preference Prediction
problem: Predict which of two LLM responses a human will prefer, as a three-class problem including ties.

title: Enveda CASMI 2026 — Molecule ID
problem: Predict a small molecule's 2D structure from its tandem mass spectra, submitting up to 25 ranked candidate structures.
constraint: Exact skeleton match on a tautomer-canonical key, so it is a retrieval and ranking problem rather than a generation one

title: Orbit Wars
problem: Write a bot that launches fleets between rotating planets on a continuous board and holds the most ships after 500 turns.
constraint: One second of compute per turn

outcome.context: best of 20 submissions across bot versions
